criteria.requirement: Implement dotenv.validation.parse_config(text, *, required=(), duplicates="error") returning immutable ParsedConfig(values, lines), using the pinned parser and its actual original line numbers. Collect syntax, duplicate and missing/value-less required-key issues into ConfigValidationError.issues tuples (code,key,line), in source order then required order; errors must not include secret values. Empty assigned values satisfy required. duplicates="last" preserves last definition and its line. Do not interpolate, touch os.environ, print secret content, or change permissive dotenv_values behavior.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
